title: 2.2.20 Count a Letter in a Word
description: Loop through a string and count how many times one letter appears. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: book 2.2.4: 'Introduction to Loops', Example 2.2.6 (the letter-counting half)

steps.title: Loop over every position
steps.instructions: Write a for loop whose counter i runs from 0 while i is less than word.length. Use < and not <=, or the last round reaches a position that does not exist.

steps.title: Test each character
steps.instructions: Inside the loop, use an if to check whether word[i] is the letter you are counting.

steps.title: Keep a running total
steps.instructions: When the if matches, add 1 to count. After the loop finishes, log count.

planChart.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A([Start]) --> B[set word and count to 0]
  B --> C{more letters}
  C -- yes --> D{letter matches}
  D -- yes --> E[add 1 to count]
  D -- no --> C
  E --> C
  C -- no --> F[/log count/]
  F --> G([End])
